2) Contract: Legal (cc'd Tom) will do a quick review but will likely request a couple of small redlines around data processing and liability caps.
3) Security: Luis (cc'd) will run the Redwood evidence checklist - please point us to the SOC2 summary and any encryption/KMS docs.

Tentative internal timeline (we'll confirm):
- Legal redlines: 1 week
- Security evidence review + questions: 1-2 weeks
- Finance PO issuance: target within 1 week after legal/security signoff

So overall we're hoping to have a PO issued by ~2026-04-08 if reviews are on the short end. Please confirm if that timeline aligns with your delivery commitments for pilot access.
